name: 拉普拉斯金字塔残差分析
description: Analyzes Laplacian pyramid residual energy distribution across scales (Burt & Adelson, 1983).
mechanism:
This method applies the Burt-Adelson Laplacian pyramid decomposition to analyze multi-scale residual structures:

1. **GaussianPyramidConstruction**: The image is iteratively low-pass filtered and downsampled by factor 2 to build a Gaussian pyramid G₀, G₁, ..., Gₙ. Each level captures progressively coarser spatial information.

2. **LaplacianResidual计算**: Each Laplacian level Lₖ = Gₖ − expand(Gₖ₊₁) captures the band-pass detail lost between consecutive Gaussian levels. These residuals encode edges, textures, and fine structures at each spatial scale.

3. **Cross-Scale相关性分析**: Natural images exhibit characteristic statistical dependencies between Laplacian pyramid levels — adjacent scales show predictable correlation patterns governed by the 1/f power spectrum of natural scenes. AI-generated images often violate these cross-scale relationships.

4. **Kurtosisand分布Profiling**: The coefficient distributions at each pyramid level are analyzed. Natural image Laplacian coefficients follow a leptokurtic (heavy-tailed) distribution well modeled by generalized Gaussian. GAN/diffusion artifacts produce deviations from these expected distributions.

5. **ResidualEnergy评分**: The energy (sum of squared coefficients) at each level is computed and compared against natural image statistics. Anomalous energy distributions across scales indicate synthetic generation or manipulation.
parameters: 分析类型：自动统计\n分数范围：0（真实）到100（AI生成）
accuracy: 中到高 — 根据输入质量，准确率为70-85%。
source: 基于数字取证和AI内容检测的同行评审研究。
useCase: 作为多信号分析管道的一部分，用于检测AI生成的内容。
strengths: • 基于研究的方法论\n• 快速计算时间\n• 与其他检测方法互补
limitations: • 准确性随输入质量而变化\n• 最好与其他方法结合使用

references.title: Burt, P.J. & Adelson, E.H. (1983). The Laplacian Pyramid as a Compact Image Code. IEEE Trans. Communications.
Adelson, E.H. et al. (1984). Pyramid Methods in Image Processing. RCA Engineer.
